feeds.title: Teach Piano Today Blog
feeds.description: Discover the piano teaching tips, advice, and resources that are helping our piano teachers build successful studios. Piano teaching bloggers and publishers offering piano teachers unique lesson materials on TeachPianoToday.com and through WunderKeys.com, PianoBookClub.com and PianoGameClub.com.

feeds.title: Compose Create Blog
feeds.description: My goal is to help piano teachers and music teachers to flourish, so you will find hundreds of articles, resources, and music to do just that. Compose Create helps make your piano teaching business exciting, creative, and financially successful!

feeds.title: Color In My Piano
feeds.description: Welcome! ColorInMyPiano.com is blog by Joy Morin dedicated to excellence in piano teaching. Explore within to find inspiration, ideas, and resources.

feeds.title: Practising the Piano Blog
feeds.description: Featuring a comprehensive library of lessons, articles and resources, the Practising the Piano Online Academy is the ultimate online resource for pianists, teachers and anyone seeking to master the piano. Graham Fitch, based in London, maintains an international career not only as a pianist, but also as a teacher, adjudicator, examiner, lecturer, writer and commentator on piano playing and musical subjects.

feeds.title: Susan Paradis Piano Teaching Resources Blog
feeds.description: On this site you will find a treasure chest of colorful, creative and fun piano teaching material. Be sure to check out the high quality sheet music in my store that will motivate and engage your students. I'm Susan Paradis and I have been a music teacher for most of my life. I started as a little girl teaching my friends how to play duets and carry a tune.

feeds.title: Melanie Spanswick
feeds.description: Melanie Spanswick hosts the Classical Piano and Music Education Blog. She writes about practising the piano, piano music and all aspects of music education. In demand as a writer, teacher and composer, Melanie frequently directs piano courses and workshops worldwide, and she also adjudicates and judges piano competitions and festivals. She has written, amongst many other publications, the three-book piano course Play it again: PIANO, published by Schott Music, which has become an international best-selling series.

feeds.title: Colourful Keys Piano Studio Blog
feeds.description: Inspiring resources for piano teachers who want to include creativity in their lessons. Find piano teaching tips, tricks, ideas and more at Colourful Keys. Nicola is a piano teacher, blogger and creator. She teaches through laughter and exploration. Find fun teaching ideas on her blog

feeds.title: Melody Payne Blog
feeds.description: Dr. Melody Hanberry Payne is a classically trained pianist and enjoys teaching piano lessons in her home studio to children and adults of all ages and abilities. She writes blog posts on a variety of relevant topics for piano teachers, and she and her team create and sell piano teaching resources and sheet music in her online music resources store for piano teachers and students around the world.

feeds.title: Chatalbash Lessons Blog
feeds.description: The most educational blog for potential piano players in the country, providing articles and videos, as well as information on 1-on-1 and group lessons. I'm Sara, the Piano Teacher Who Makes Playing Piano Simple.

feeds.title: Arioso7's Blog
feeds.description: Arioso7's Blog is a journal of a piano teacher (Shirley Kirsten) from New York to California. Shirley is an International Online Piano Teacher, blogger, recording artist, composer, piano finder, freelance writer, film maker and story teller.

feeds.title: Leila Viss Blog
feeds.description: A blog by Leila Viss: creative, tech-savvy and pedagogically sound ideas and resources for piano teachers. My site includes music app suggestions, dynamic teaching tips, off-bench activities, clever ways to teach with household, repurposed items and original compositions and arrangements. As a longtime pianist, organist, composer, and piano teacher, Leila is recognized for her stash of strategies and solutions that energize her students and fellow teachers.

feeds.title: Piano Pantry Blog
feeds.description: If you're a piano teacher looking for resources to help make your life easier, then you're in the right place! My name is Amy Chaplin and I love sharing tips and resources on teaching, managing an independent studio business, and getting (and staying) organized.

feeds.title: anitaelise piano studio Blog
feeds.description: Explore my piano teaching blog to know more about my teaching techniques. Hello, I'm Anita Elise Kohli and and piano teaching is my career, my hobby and my vocation.

feeds.title: Portland Piano Lab Blog
feeds.description: The Portland Piano Lab offers innovative, cutting-edge, customized instruction with an emphasis on building fundamental musicianship skills and liberating musical expression and creativity. Get complete details about piano lessons for adults and teens. Learn more about the musical journey by checking out popular blog posts. The Piano Lab Blog features fresh ideas, tips, and inspiration for piano teachers & students.

feeds.title: Cascade Method Blog
feeds.description: Fun tools, tips, and tricks to teaching piano for kids. The Cascade Method is all about empowering piano teachers and inspiring students of all ages to discover the joy of learning to play the piano. For creative piano teachers who want the best for their students, the Cascade Method Training Program provides fun, engaging resources and unique modern methods inside a self-paced online course!

feeds.title: Creative Piano Teacher Blog
feeds.description: Music-loving bloggers who aim for creativity in lessons. Follow us for fun freebies, piano teaching tips, inspiring ideas, and more! Creative Piano Teacher helps you cut through the noise and find the latest and greatest piano teaching repertoire and resources! We are an independent piano teacher, Davis Dorrough, and a university professor, Dr. Olivia Ellis, teaming up to provide you with creative ideas for enhancing music education.

feeds.title: The Curious Piano Teachers Blog
feeds.description: Find out how The Curious Piano Teachers can help you become more confident and professional in your day-to-day piano teaching. The Curious Piano Teachers was founded in 2015 by Dr Sally Cathcart and Sharon Mark-Teggart. Both are outstanding teachers and communicators as well researchers in music education. Together they created this unique on-line resource specially for piano teachers.

feeds.title: Cool Piano Teacher Blog
feeds.description: Cool Piano Teacher LLC is a music education company that offers online and in-person jazz piano lessons. he company is founded by Alex Bohrer, a jazz pianist, and composer with over 25 years of experience. The Cool Piano Teacher website offers a variety of resources for students, including video lessons, articles, and a blog. The website also features a store where students can purchase music books, sheet music, and other accessories.

feeds.title: Cool Piano Teacher Blog
feeds.description: Explore our blog to get more tips and advice about piano classes and more! Originally from Boston, Mass. Alex started playing piano at age 9 and began playing professionally at age 14 graduating from Berklee College of Music with a music degree in Jazz Piano Performance in 1981.
